name: Crowd of Me
description: Crossing an empty city intersection at dusk, the subject multiplies until copies fill the whole street.

wardrobe.man: a camel trench coat over a white t-shirt and dark jeans
wardrobe.woman: a camel trench coat over a white t-shirt and dark jeans
wardrobe.person: a camel trench coat over a white t-shirt and dark jeans

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} walks alone across a wide empty city crosswalk at dusk, toward the camera, mid-stride, wearing {wardrobe}. Tall glass buildings line the avenue, the white stripes of the crosswalk run toward the lens, the sky is deep blue with the last orange light on the horizon, and the streetlights are just coming on. Wide shot at eye level from the middle of the street, the {subject} centered, full body visible, the avenue vanishing behind {them}. Cinematic dusk photography, warm streetlights and cool blue sky. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, blank facades and plain unbranded storefronts throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY walks across the crosswalk toward the camera at a steady pace, eyes on a point just past the camera. With every step, identical copies of the {subject} in the same trench coat step out from behind {them} and from both sides, the copies multiplying again and again, until by the last second the whole crosswalk is filled with dozens of identical copies walking toward the camera in perfect step, the original still in front and center. The camera dollies backward at walking pace. Sound: footsteps multiplying into the rhythm of a marching crowd, a low city hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, crowd duplication with consistent identity, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame carries on with exactly the same action. Identical copies of the {subject} in the same clothes step out from behind {them} and from both sides, multiplying again and again, until by the last second dozens of identical copies fill the space around the original, all moving in perfect sync. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: footsteps multiplying into the rhythm of a crowd. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, crowd duplication with consistent identity, sharp detail, stable picture.
